heading: EXT. CATTLE GRID BRIDGE OVER DRY RIVERBED - DAWN

units.text: EXT. CATTLE GRID BRIDGE OVER DRY RIVERBED - DAWN
A rickety wooden bridge spanning a dry wash.
A single telegraph pole leans beside it, wires humming.
The sun is a pale coin over the mesa.
MARSHAL AMBROSE DRUMMOND-ASANTE (50s) stands at the center of the bridge with his rifle slung.
He watches the horizon.
Fifteen yards behind him, a woman in a worn blue dress sits on a crate, her wrists bound in front of her: AUGUSTINA "GUSSIE" RAINWATER-OKORO (30s).
Neither of them speaks.
The telegraph key clatters on the pole's receiver box, a small brass box bolted to the wood.
Ambrose crosses to it, listens, and writes in a notebook.
Marshal Drummond. Judge arrives Thursday. Hold prisoner at bridge. Stop.
units.name: AMBROSE

units.text: Thursday. It's Monday.
units.name: AMBROSE

units.text: Marshal?
units.name: GUSSIE

units.text: Quiet.
units.name: AMBROSE

units.text: I'm only asking.
units.name: GUSSIE

units.text: Ask quietly.
units.name: AMBROSE

units.text: He tears the page from the notebook and tucks it into his vest.
A dust plume rises on the far side of the wash.
A single rider, coming fast.
Who's that?
units.name: GUSSIE

units.text: I don't know.
units.name: AMBROSE

units.text: The rider reins in at the bridge, a woman in a dusty brown duster, her hat pulled low: DEPUTY PRUDENCE LOCKHART-ADEBOYE (30s).
She dismounts and approaches, hands visible.
Marshal. Sorry I'm late.
units.name: PRUDENCE

units.text: You're not late. You're not expected.
units.name: AMBROSE

units.text: Judge Hollis sent me. He wants her at the courthouse by noon.
units.name: PRUDENCE

units.text: The wire says Thursday.
units.name: AMBROSE

units.text: Wire's wrong.
units.name: PRUDENCE

units.text: Gussie looks from one to the other, her face unreadable.
The wires hum.
Show me the order.
units.name: AMBROSE

units.text: Prudence hands over a folded paper.
He reads, nods slowly, and lets out a breath.
Judge's hand. All right.
units.name: AMBROSE

units.text: He unties Gussie's wrists himself.
She rubs them, flexing her fingers.
I told you I'd be no trouble.
units.name: GUSSIE

units.text: You've been trouble since Sunday.
units.name: AMBROSE

units.text: She smiles, almost.
Prudence leads the horses forward and the three of them start across the bridge.
